title: Denver Graffiti Happy Hour Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
**SPRING-SUMMER-FALL**

Enjoy a cool drink and explore some of the best street art in the country on this acclaimed two-hour walking tour of the RiNo Art District. Whether visiting Denver for the first time or a Mile High native, you'll see the street art and this neighborhood in a new light. 

On this tour, you will discover the city’s cultural underground hiding in plain sight. We live right here and personally know the artists + art. So you'll learn the real stories about the art, artists and neighborhoods, including how Denver has changed and how that’s affected the art being made and the people who live here. 

We give people a class on street art, and an introduction a new and unsung side of Denver.

PLEASE NOTE: We stop for drinks for roughly 30-40 minutes, but tour price DOES NOT include cost of drinks. We don't fold that in, because we realize not all guests will want to drink. 

(And! We offer private tours, just ask via email)
